rv.q: The chemistry between the four leads is apparent from the balcony in the way back, and they are the cherry on top of the best touring production that I’ve reviewed at TPAC so far this year.
I wouldn’t be at all surprised if Jersey Boys, co-written by Rick Elice and Marshall Brickman (with this production directed by Des McAnuff), runs for another 20 years.
If you want to see the standard that all jukebox musicals should live up to, this is the the category-defining show.
A fabulous evening showcasing exceptional talent—and a show that is well worth seeing!

cn.t: This enduring jukebox musical about Frankie Valli and The Four Seasons continues to fill theaters 20 years later with its effective storytelling and seamless integration of iconic hits into the group's dramatic rise and fall.
